name: Mixin Network
rootCause: What a way to start the week. This morning, Mixin Network announced a loss of $200M. The project claims to be “decentralised”, but has blamed the losses on a hacked third-party database. Where's the accountability?

descriptions.text: What a way to start the week. This morning, Mixin Network announced a loss of $200M. The project claims to be “decentralised”, but has blamed the losses on a hacked third-party database. Where's the accountability?
On September 23, the Mixin Network cloud service provider database was attacked, the amount of funds involved was ~$200M.

On September 23, 2023, Mixin Network suffered a breach of its cloud service provider’s database, allowing attackers to drain approximately $200 million in crypto from hot wallets controlled via this infrastructure. The incident stemmed from centralized custody of keys within a supposedly decentralized architecture. Mixin Network's off-chain infrastructure relied on a centralized cloud-service-provider database that stored credentials or cryptographic shares required to operate its hot wallets.
